title: Roofer Estimate Template
subtitle: A professional estimate pre-filled for roofing jobs — per-square pricing, tear-off, underlayment, labor and materials. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days of acceptance. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. Estimate valid for 30 days. A 25% deposit is due at signing; the balance is due upon completion.
features: Auto-calculating totals in Excel — subtotal, 25% deposit and balance update automatically
Pre-filled roofing line items: per-square installation, tear-off, underlayment, labor, permits
Valid-until date and deposit line built in — standard practice for roofing contracts
Exclusions note field so scope stays clear

faqs.q: What should I include on a roofing estimate?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and job-site address, dated line items with per-square pricing (installation, tear-off, underlayment), labor, materials and permit fees, plus a valid-until date, deposit terms and exclusions. Most states require a contractor license number on client-facing documents.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate the deposit and balance automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, 25% deposit and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
